Lexical decision with participants and words

Source: R/data.R
lexical_decision.Rd

20 participants each respond to the same 40 words. Participants differ in speed and in the size of their frequency effect; words differ in difficulty. For crossed random effects.

Usage

lexical_decision

Format

A tibble with 800 rows and 5 columns:

participant

Participant ID, P01 to P20.

word

Word ID, w01 to w40.

log_freq

log10 word frequency, 1 to 6.

freq_c

log_freq, centred on the mean of the 40 words.

rt

Reaction time in ms.

Source

data-raw/lexical_decision.R

Details

True model: log(rt) = 6.47 + u0 + w0 + (-0.045 + u1) * freq_c + e. By-participant intercepts u0 have SD 0.11 and slopes u1 SD 0.025, correlated at -0.6; by-word intercepts w0 have SD 0.045; residual SD 0.075. languageR::lexdec is a different data set, with real data.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("lme4", quietly = TRUE)) {
  m <- lme4::lmer(log(rt) ~ freq_c + (1 + freq_c | participant) + (1 | word),
                  data = lexical_decision)
  summary(m)
}
#> Linear mixed model fit by REML ['lmerMod']
